claimText:
Refine the active `ela30-1-modern-drama` frame topbar and remove the duplicate Readings section because PDFs now live in Library.

Goal:
- Keep Library as the document/PDF section.
- Remove the Readings sidebar link, hash route, generated section, route allow-list entry, and section-map entry.
- Put the white Next Step CE logo in the topbar center.
- Move the lesson progress bar into a compact top-right position.
- Remove the centered unit title/progress stack from the topbar.
- Regenerate the `ela30-1-modern-drama` workspace/meta output from the ELA 30-1 Brightspace export.

Acceptance boundary:
- Edit the ELA generator, focused generator test, and regenerated `ela30-1-modern-drama` project files only.
- Preserve the existing Streetcar lesson, Library, Film Room, Resources, progress, and sidebar-collapse behavior.
- Do not wire in other ELA units right now.

STAX acknowledgement:

Objective:
Refine the active `ela30-1-modern-drama` frame by removing the duplicate Readings section, keeping Library as the PDF/document route, placing the white Next Step CE logo in the exact topbar center, and keeping lesson progress in the top-right corner.

Tests added:
- Updated `scripts/tests/ela-modern-drama-frame.test.ts` to assert Readings is absent from generated nav/routes.
- Updated the topbar regression to require `assets/brand/nxt-ce-logo-white-with-ce.png`, no top-left course icon/label, equal grid columns, centered logo placement, no logo background/padding, and top-right progress.

Commands run:
- `npx tsx --test scripts/tests/ela-modern-drama-frame.test.ts` after adding the Readings-removal expectation - exit 1, expected red failure because `data-page-target="readings"` still existed.
- `npx tsx --test scripts/tests/ela-modern-drama-frame.test.ts` after removing Readings from the generator - exit 0.
- `npx tsx --test scripts/tests/ela-modern-drama-frame.test.ts` after adding the topbar/logo expectations - exit 1, expected red failure because the header still referenced the previous logo/unequal grid.
- `npx tsx --test scripts/tests/ela-modern-drama-frame.test.ts` after updating the CE logo and centered grid - exit 0.
- `npx tsx scripts/build-ela-modern-drama.ts --zip "C:\Users\dean.guedo\Downloads\D2LExport_6670_CBE System ELA 30-1 (Winter 2020)_20266815.zip" --slug ela30-1-modern-drama --force` - exit 0.
- Structural checks with `rg`, `Select-String`, `Test-Path`, and `Get-Item` over generated workspace/meta/logo files - exit 0 for positive checks and exit 1 for expected no-match scans.
- Playwright geometry/runtime check against `http://127.0.0.1:5174/preview/workspace/ela30-1-modern-drama/index.html?rev=20260608-ce-logo#lessons` - exit 0.
- `npm run verify -- --project ela30-1-modern-drama --mode workspace` - exit 0.
- `npm run typecheck` - exit 0.
- `npm run build:studio` - exit 0.
- `npm run stax:collect-visual -- --repo "C:\Users\dean.guedo\Documents\GitHub\canvas-helper" --url "http://127.0.0.1:5174/preview/workspace/ela30-1-modern-drama/index.html?rev=20260608-ce-logo#lessons" --description "ELA Streetcar topbar with centered white Next Step CE logo, top-right progress, and no Readings nav" --checklist "White Next Step CE logo is centered in the topbar" --checklist "No logo or course label is in the top-left" --checklist "Progress bar is in the top-right corner and Readings is absent"` from `C:\Users\dean.guedo\Documents\GitHub\STAX` - exit 0.

Command output summary with exit codes:
- Focused generator tests passed: 7 tests, 0 failures.
- Rebuild generated 25 lessons and wrote `projects/ela30-1-modern-drama/workspace/index.html`.
- Generated workspace includes `assets/brand/nxt-ce-logo-white-with-ce.png` copied from `docs/design/next-step/assets/nxt-ce-logo-white-with-ce.png`.
- Generated workspace has `topbar-logo-link` centered with equal left/right grid tracks and no `topbar-brand`, no `theater_comedy`, no top-left ELA label, and no `course-header-title` in the topbar.
- Generated workspace and section map have no `data-page-target="readings"`, no `<section id="readings">`, and no `Readings` label.
- Playwright confirmed the CE logo centerline is exactly at viewport midpoint, the logo source is `assets/brand/nxt-ce-logo-white-with-ce.png`, progress is top-right, no Readings targets/sections exist, there is no horizontal overflow, and completing one of 25 lessons updates top progress to 4%.
- Project verification passed with no missing local assets or workspace embeds; expected external dependency warnings remain for Tailwind CDN and Google fonts/icons.
- Typecheck passed with `tsc --noEmit`.
- Studio production build passed.
- STAX visual proof captured: `visual_2026-06-08T16_02_58_046Z_5cb8ca832712`.

What is verified:
- Readings is removed from generated navigation, route handling, page markup, and `meta/section-map.json`.
- Library remains the PDF/document section.
- The fixed topbar centers the white Next Step CE logo instead of putting any logo or course label at top-left.
- The completion-linked progress control is positioned at the top-right corner.
- The progress count/percent/ARIA value still update when a lesson is marked complete.
- The regenerated workspace contains the copied CE logo asset and passes asset verification.

What is weak/provisional:
- STAX observer status may remain Reject because the sidecar has stale historical command evidence unrelated to this ELA change.
- The topbar visual was checked in Chromium desktop; responsive behavior was checked for no overflow but not on a physical Chromebook.

What is unverified:
- Brightspace package export/import has not been run for this ELA frame.
- Whether the topbar sizing needs further adjustment after teacher review inside Brightspace.

Risks:
- Forced ELA rebuilds rewrite generated timestamps in project metadata.
- Embedded YouTube videos remain network-dependent.
- Lesson completion remains localStorage preview behavior, not Brightspace gradebook persistence.
- Unrelated untracked Forensics files remain in the worktree and were not touched.

One next action:
Run STAX observer preflight, then commit and push only the ELA/STAX/handoff/logo files for this refinement.
